text:
samir.aden: Quick heads-up: launching a tiny L5x micro-pool in Nairobi (af-nbo-1) as a regional pilot. Purpose: cut client RTT for East Africa customers and test our new fair-share tweaks. :earth_africa:

keisha.ng: Nice. Any changes to reservation rules or pricing for the pilot?

samir.aden: Pilot specifics: 8x L5x nodes, 10-day reservation window for early access. No GA SLA. Billing uses the standard dedicated SKU; were offering a temporary "pilot credit" to partners to offset potential variance. There is a new regional fair-share policy in effect for the pilot window.

infra-bot: [automated] pool-create: dedicated-l5x-af-nbo-1-01 created (8x L5x). Telemetry: latency/p50,p95,thermal.

ops-oncall: Ops note: fair-share change = we lower per-tenant soft concurrency cap from 40% -> 30% when contention >70% to reduce noisy neighbors. Reservations get protected back to 100% of the reserved capacity during their window. Non-reserved jobs are eligible for soft reclaim during high pressure.

sales-africa: Question from a partner: can we guarantee fallback to our Lagos region if NBO spikes?

samir.aden: Fallback routing to ng-west-1 (Lagos) is enabled but it's best-effort and will add ~20-50ms of extra RTT. For latency-critical routes recommend customers reserve.

platform-qa: Any behavior changes for batching or adaptive kv-cache?

ops-oncall: No runtime changes for caching/batching in pilot. Were only toggling the fair-share throttle and reservation protection. If telemetry looks good we'll consider enabling adaptive batch expansion in 72h.

sre-bot: [automated] alert rule created: l5x-af-nbo-1-thermal (warn 82%, critical 94%).

keisha.ng: Can we get a 1-pager for account teams and a short playbook for incident handoffs?

samir.aden: Yep  I dropped a short playbook in Confluence and pinged AMs. Link (internal): https://redwood.internal/docs/dedicated/af-nbo-l5x-pilot. Playbook highlights: reserve-first, include reservation id in tickets, and contact infra-oncall for fallback routing.

ops-oncall: Runbook snippets:
```
# reserve pilot capacity
rcli reserve --region af-nbo-1 --gpu L5x --count 1 --days 10
# check pool status
rcli pool status --name dedicated-l5x-af-nbo-1-01
# request fallback to ng-west-1 (Lagos)
rcli pool fallback --from af-nbo-1 --to ng-west-1 --reservation <id>
```

sales-africa: We'll gate partner offers to vetted POCs only and include the pilot credit details in the signup flow. No GA promises.

sre-bot: [automated] metric rule added: l5x-af-nbo-1-util (warn 75%, critical 90%).

samir.aden: We'll run a telemetry check at 48h and a final review at 96h. If heat/latency are stable we'll expand capacity and relax the fair-share throttle; if not we'll keep pilot constraints and update partners. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
